## 🤖 Autonomous Meme Coin Agent
Schedule → **Trend Scout** (DexScreener) → two **Writer Agents** (Gemini) → **Judge Agent** → **Logo Artist** (Pollinations Flux) → **IPFS** (Pinata) → **your bot** signs & launches on pump.fun.

The bot enforces daily limits, the name filter and DRY_RUN. Nothing is sold automatically.

### Setup (credentials → *Header Auth*)
1. **Google Gemini(PaLM) Api**: your key from aistudio.google.com/apikey
2. **Pinata JWT**: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <JWT>`
3. **Meme Bot**: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <AGENT_API_TOKEN>`
4. Activate the workflow. The bot checks in its tunnel URL automatically.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: 'You are a degen crypto copywriter with sharp, punchy humor who invents Solana meme coins for pump.fun. Trend word: "' + $('Trend Scout').first().json.theme + '". Invent ONE original coin built around it. Rules: never use real people, brands, celebrities or existing famous coins/tickers; no promises of profit. Reply ONLY with JSON: {"name": 2-32 chars, "ticker": 3-8 uppercase letters, "description": one absurd funny sentence max 200 chars, "imagePrompt": vivid description of ONE cartoon mascot for the logo, no text, "twitterHook": short punchy line}' }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 1.1, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: 'You are a surreal absurdist comedian who loves weird animal mascots who invents Solana meme coins for pump.fun. Trend word: "' + $('Trend Scout').first().json.theme + '". Invent ONE original coin built around it. Rules: never use real people, brands, celebrities or existing famous coins/tickers; no promises of profit. Reply ONLY with JSON: {"name": 2-32 chars, "ticker": 3-8 uppercase letters, "description": one absurd funny sentence max 200 chars, "imagePrompt": vivid description of ONE cartoon mascot for the logo, no text, "twitterHook": short punchy line}' }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 1.3, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: 'You judge meme coin concepts for the trend "' + $json.theme + '". Score each 0-10 for humor, memorability, ticker punchiness and fit to the trend. Penalize anything resembling a real person, brand or existing coin. Concepts: ' + JSON.stringify($json.concepts.map((c, i) => ({ i, name: c.name, ticker: c.ticker, description: c.description }))) + '. Reply ONLY with JSON {"scores": [one number per concept, same order], "why": short reason}' }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.2, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/' + encodeURIComponent($json.imagePrompt + '. Square meme-coin logo, single bold mascot centered, thick clean outlines, vivid flat colors, simple solid background, high contrast, no text, no letters, no watermark') + '?width=1024&height=1024&model=flux&nologo=true&seed=' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e9) }}
